title: Replace a helmet visor
instruction: Release both catches and replace the raised visor with the spare. Close and reopen the replacement to check both sides are secure, then put the old visor in the tray and let go.
context: A curved visor must be aligned at two spaced hinge bases and retained by both catches. A successful fit must still open and close.
setup: Development: full-size inert helmet on a bench stand, 2 mm polycarbonate curved visor, replacement visor, two spring release triggers, spare supports and tray. Exact dimensions in geometry.py.
scoring: Development: 0.25 for releasing the old visor, 0.5 for seating one replacement catch, 0.75 for both. Full score also needs a close-and-reopen check, old visor in tray and release for two seconds. Broken parts invalidate the trial.
fidelity: The visor has a rigid curved centre and compliant end ears. Spring trigger movement releases the native hinge constraints. Local hook seating is approximated by capture within 2.5 mm and 6 degrees at low speed; no object pose is written. This is a generic two-catch quick-release design, not a certified replacement part. The helmet is inert and not worn by a person.
scores: Development only: not validated; do not submit.
